papers.title: TAVR in Patients with Moderate Aortic Stenosis with At-Risk Features.
papers.summary: Among 744 patients with moderate aortic stenosis and at least one at-risk feature, randomised 1:1 to transfemoral TAVR with a balloon-expandable valve or clinical surveillance, death or a heart-failure event at 2 years was 16.7% vs 23.9% (risk difference −7.2 percentage points; 95% CI −13.1 to −1.3; P=0.02). Death was similar (8.4% vs 7.3%); heart-failure events were 10.8% vs 19.0%. Procedure-related adverse events were comparable among those who underwent aortic-valve replacement.
papers.short_title: TAVR versus surveillance for moderate aortic stenosis with at-risk features in PROGRESS

papers.title: Antithrombotic Therapy After Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion: The SIMPLAAFY Randomized Clinical Trial.
papers.summary: In this open-label US trial, 1,857 patients after successful left atrial appendage closure were randomised 1:1:1 to 6 months of dual antiplatelet therapy, 3 months of reduced-dose NOAC then aspirin, or aspirin alone. The 6-month composite of death, stroke, systemic embolism or major bleeding occurred in 6.9% with DAPT, 5.1% with reduced-dose NOAC and 3.3% with aspirin alone; both monotherapy strategies met noninferiority versus DAPT (P<0.001 for noninferiority). Major bleeding was 4.5%, 2.7% and 1.7%, and device-related thrombus 3.4%, 0.9% and 2.7%.
papers.short_title: antithrombotic therapy after left atrial appendage occlusion in SIMPLAAFY

papers.title: Impact of CKD and Hemodialysis on Treatment of Severely Calcified Lesions: The ECLIPSE Trial.
papers.summary: In this pre-specified CKD sub-analysis of ECLIPSE, 2,001 patients with severely calcified lesions were randomised to orbital atherectomy or balloon angioplasty before DES; CKD was present in 34.7%, including 112 on hemodialysis. Two-year target-vessel failure was higher with CKD (21.2% vs 11.6%), and hemodialysis independently predicted TVF (adjusted HR 2.14). Among hemodialysis patients, TVF was higher after orbital atherectomy than balloon angioplasty (52.3% vs 30.7%; adjusted HR 2.50), though the treatment-by-hemodialysis interaction was not significant.
papers.study_type: Pre-specified subgroup analysis of a randomised trial
papers.short_title: CKD and hemodialysis outcomes after orbital atherectomy in ECLIPSE

papers.title: Performance of the PREVENT-HF Equations Across Heart Failure Subtypes in Community-Based and Ambulatory Healthcare Samples.
papers.summary: Across pooled cohorts (23,652 adults) and two EHR samples, PREVENT-HF predicted 10-year HFpEF and HFrEF with excellent discrimination, better for HFpEF than HFrEF (AUROC 0.824 vs 0.789 in cohorts; similar gaps in BIDMC and MGB). Calibration was similar for both subtypes. Subtype-specific risk thresholds still need defining.
papers.study_type: Validation study across cohorts and EHR samples
papers.short_title: PREVENT-HF risk equations across heart failure subtypes
